population.definition: Resident population of the City of Kigali (province-level unit with districts Nyarugenge, Gasabo, Kicukiro) enumerated in the Fifth Population and Housing Census as of 15 August 2022 (fieldwork 16-30 August 2022); density 2,401 per km2; 86.9% urban.

source.title: The Fifth Rwanda Population and Housing Census 2022, Main Indicators Report (Table 1)
source.publisher: National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda (NISR)
source.author: NISR
source.quote: The 5th Rwanda Population and Housing Census enumerated 13,246,394 residents in Rwanda as of August 15th, 2022. (Table 1: City of Kigali 1,745,555)

facts.claim: Kigali was reported as celebrating 100 years of existence in 2007, consistent with a 1907 founding. Another New Times history says Germany appointed Dr Richard Kandt as first imperial resident governor for Rwanda in 1906 (dates differ between sources).

source.title: Kigali, vast area through 100 years
source.author: Times Reporter
source.quote: Kigali is still engrossed in celebrating 100 years of existence.

facts.claim: Kandt was the German colonial resident in Rwanda (1906 appointment per this source).

source.title: The history of City of Kigali
source.author: Times Reporter
source.quote: In 1906 Germany appointed Dr. Richard Kandt as the first imperial resident governor for Rwanda.

facts.claim: After independence (1962) the new republic made Kigali the capital.

source.title: The history of City of Kigali
source.author: Times Reporter
source.quote: After independence, the new Rwandan republic decided to turn Kigali into the capital.

facts.claim: Rapid growth: from about 6,000 people in 1962 to roughly 1 million by 2011 (press figure); the 2022 census counted 1,745,555 residents.

source.title: The history of City of Kigali
source.author: Times Reporter
source.quote: Kigali has grown from a population of 6000 people in 1962 ... approximately 1 million inhabitants

facts.claim: Kigali has a master plan: the 2013 plan was updated (Kigali Master Plan 2050) by Surbana Jurong/SMEC; the project page lists a projected 2050 population of 3.8 million versus 1.3 million existing.

source.title: Kigali Masterplan | Projects
source.quote: Building on the 2013 plan, this next-generation update adopts a data-rich, participatory methodology

timeline.claim: Kigali marked as founded in 1907 (centenary celebrated in 2007); Kandt, German colonial resident, associated with the founding. Sources differ on Kandt's appointment (1906 per New Times).

source.title: Kigali, vast area through 100 years
source.author: Times Reporter
source.quote: Kigali is still engrossed in celebrating 100 years of existence.

timeline.claim: After independence Kigali becomes capital of the Rwandan republic; population then about 6,000.

source.title: The history of City of Kigali
source.author: Times Reporter
source.quote: After independence, the new Rwandan republic decided to turn Kigali into the capital.

timeline.claim: UN Security Council Resolution 955 creates the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda to prosecute persons responsible for genocide in 1994 (genocide against the Tutsi; the page read gives the tribunal's purpose, not the phrase 'against the Tutsi').

source.title: Statute of the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda (Introductory Note)
source.publisher: United Nations Audiovisual Library of International Law
source.author: Michael P. Scharf
source.quote: an international tribunal for the sole purpose of prosecuting persons responsible for genocide

timeline.claim: Earlier Kigali master plan adopted (later updated as the 2050 plan).

source.title: Kigali Masterplan | Projects
source.quote: Building on the 2013 plan, this next-generation update adopts a data-rich, participatory methodology

timeline.claim: Kigali Convention Centre opens and days later hosts the African Union Summit.

source.title: Rwanda: Radisson Blu, KCC Mark Decade of Driving Hospitality Growth, Community Impact
source.author: Frank Ntarindwa
source.quote: Just days after opening, the convention centre hosted the 2016 African Union Summit.

timeline.claim: The former Presidential Palace Museum in Kanombe becomes the Rwanda Art Museum.

source.title: Museums and Heritages Sites Management Division
source.quote: This former Presidential Palace Museum changed into Rwanda art Museum as of 18th May 2018.

timeline.claim: Fifth national census counts 1,745,555 residents in the City of Kigali (13.2% of Rwanda).

source.title: The Fifth Rwanda Population and Housing Census 2022, Main Indicators Report
source.author: NISR
source.quote: The Northern Province and City of Kigali respectively have 15% and 13% of the total Rwanda's population.

places.name: Kimironko Market
places.what: Kimironko is one of Kigali's largest open-air markets, in Gasabo district. The City planned to rebuild it as a modern facility, and a redevelopment is under discussion as of 2026.

source.title: Kigali's largest open-air market set to open its doors to online customers
source.quote: Kimironko Market is among Kigali's largest and most expansive open air market places

source.title: Kimironko market set for Rwf24 billion upgrade
source.author: Times Reporter
source.quote: The market has 2,200 vendors.

facts.label: Upgrade plan (2013)
facts.value: Upgrade into a modern facility announced in 2013 (cost Rwf24 billion per headline)

source.title: Kimironko market set for Rwf24 billion upgrade
source.author: Times Reporter
source.quote: Construction works to upgrade Kimironko market into a modern facility are expected to kick off in July, next year.

places.name: Kandt House Museum
places.what: A national museum on Nyarugenge area, about one kilometre from downtown, in the house associated with Richard Kandt, the first German colonial resident. It is the former Natural History Museum and covers Rwandan life before colonialism, the colonial period and the history of Kigali.

facts.label: Network
facts.value: One of eight museums of the Institute of National Museums of Rwanda

source.title: Kandt House Museum
source.quote: The Kandt House Museum is one of the eight museums that make up the Institute of National Museums of Rwanda.

facts.label: Exhibition parts
facts.value: Three parts: pre-colonial life, colonial period, history of Kigali

source.title: Kandt House Museum
source.quote: The third part covers the history of Kigali, before, during and after the colonial era.

facts.label: Former use and location
facts.value: Former Natural History Museum, around 1 km from downtown, KN 90 St

source.title: Museums and Heritages Sites Management Division
source.quote: Kandt House Museum, the former Natural History Museum is located at KN 90 St, around one kilometer from downtown.

facts.label: Kandt
facts.value: First colonial governor of Rwanda for Germany

source.title: Kandt House Museum
source.quote: Richard Kandt was the first colonial governor of Rwanda, on behalf of Germany, until the early 1900s.

places.name: Rwanda Art Museum
places.what: A museum of contemporary art in Kanombe, about four kilometres from Kigali International Airport, housed in a building once home to two former Rwandan presidents. It was the Presidential Palace Museum until renamed in May 2018.

facts.label: Renaming
facts.value: Presidential Palace Museum became Rwanda Art Museum on 18 May 2018

source.title: Museums and Heritages Sites Management Division
source.quote: This former Presidential Palace Museum changed into Rwanda art Museum as of 18th May 2018.

facts.label: Status
facts.value: Described in 2018 as the country's only contemporary art museum

source.title: Rwanda Art Museum opens to public
source.author: Moses Opobo
source.quote: The country's sole museum of contemporary art.

facts.label: Building
facts.value: Historic building, home to two former presidents

source.title: Rwanda Art Museum opens to public
source.author: Moses Opobo
source.quote: located in the historic building that was once home to two former Rwandan presidents.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: Kanombe, about 4 km from the airport

source.title: Rwanda Art Museum opens to public
source.author: Moses Opobo
source.quote: is located in Kanombe, about four kilometers from the Kigali International Airport.

places.name: Inema Arts Center
places.what: A privately run arts centre in Kigali (Kacyiru) showing contemporary African art, founded in 2012 by two self-taught painter brothers. It runs a gallery, courses and programmes for artists.

facts.label: Founded
facts.value: 2012 by Emmanuel Nkuranga and Innocent Nkurunziza

source.title: Inema Arts Centre
source.author: Times Reporter
source.quote: Inema Arts Centre was founded in 2012 by self-taught brothers Emmanuel Nkuranga and Innocent Nkurunziza.

facts.label: Focus
facts.value: Contemporary African arts, crafts, music and dance

source.title: Inema Arts Centre
source.author: Times Reporter
source.quote: contemporary African arts, crafts, music and dance

source.title: Inema Arts Centre
source.author: Times Reporter
source.quote: located in Kacyiru

source.title: About
